newsitem.title: USA: Morocco may have cancelled 120,000 T wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Morocco may have cancelled 120,000 T wheat tender.

text.p: Morocco may have cancelled its 120,000 tonnes tender of optional origin wheat, several U.S. exporters said.
"I think what happened is they they passed on the go around and then they cancelled. That is the trade talk," one U.S. exporter said.
Another U.S. wheat exporter said Morocco passed due to price. "They just think (the price) will go lower," he said.
On July 29, Morocco launched a tender to buy 120,000 tonnes of optional wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said.
The wheat was divided into several different shipment periods, the exporter said.
